data.body: The concurrency group is keyed by `github.sha`, but `LAYER_NAME` (`aws-durable-execution-sdk-java-otel-plugin`) is a single, fixed-name, multi-region AWS resource, not a per-commit one. A `workflow_dispatch` run from `main` racing a `release` run for an older tag, or two releases published close together, get different `github.sha` values and therefore execute concurrently, each running its own `list-layer-versions` -> `publish-layer-version` -> `add-layer-version-permission` sequence against the same layer name across every configured region at the same time — exactly the shared-resource race this repo already guards against elsewhere with a static concurrency group (see `conformance-tests.yml`, `e2e-tests.yml`, both with comments explaining why). It also relies on `github.sha` reflecting the tagged commit for `release` events, which GitHub does not guarantee (it can reflect the default branch tip at event time instead of the release's target commit), even though checkout already pins to the correct `SOURCE_REF` independently. Use a static group name so all publish runs against this shared layer are fully serialized instead of keyed per commit.
